text: Look for hints of the lost sizes: any built css copies or docs mentioning the clock time size or landing brand font-size, and how the landing brand span is sized elsewhere.
command: cd /work && timeout 20 grep -rnE 'radar-clock-time|landing-brand' knowledge-base docs apps/canvas/index.html apps/canvas/public tests/e2e-ui 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-240 | head -20; sed -n 62,100p apps/canvas/src/styles/landing.css
